name: git-reset-hard-naming-keel-denies
description: `git reset --hard` rewrites the whole working tree from a commit, including any .keel/ path it names - the mode flag alone proves the write shape, so this does not even need a `--`. A fresh plan is on file, so a pre-fix gate would have allowed this outright; only this rule's own presence refuses it.
